words: Audit after B-97qx and B-db8w: at sprite size and full-body cameras the game mesh shows no loss; what remains is close-range and comes from two causes. Real geometry faults (the step under the tail root, the ear-root bridge and its dark bake patch) are fixable; the rest (rounder toe ends, muzzle and instep at extreme close range) is the cost of an 11,500-triangle budget and is carried by the normal map. Outcome: rescope the next pass to the three geometry faults plus smoothing the fore paw claw-seat facets, using the 500 spare triangles, then present to Nick with the budget-limited differences named.
